items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, he wasn’t around at that time. He was still out in Chicago. Sun Ra came around here like in the late 50s, and he brought some guys with him from Chicago.

ctx.x: This is 1959, 1960 and right around the corner, John Coltrane, Eric Dolphy. Had you seen Sun Ra because he was also pioneering new expressions?
No, he wasn’t around at that time. He was still out in Chicago. Sun Ra came around here like in the late 50s, and he brought some guys with him from Chicago.
